title: Bounded compatible pull-back forms for a C^∞ map that is proper on A and has ‖Df‖ ≤ Λ on an open O ⊇ A (supplied Steps 2–3)
statement: Notation: ℝ^p := Eucl p; D^q(ℝ^p) := TestFormOn univ q; |γ| := covectorEuclideanNorm γ; for a covector γ on ℝ^{m′} and a continuous linear map T : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, γ∘T := γ.compContinuousLinearMap T; C^∞ means ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞). Let m, m′, k ∈ ℕ, let f : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} be C^∞, let A ⊆ O ⊆ ℝ^m with O open, and let Λ ∈ ℝ≥0 with ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ Λ for every x ∈ O. Assume that f is proper on A: f⁻¹(K) ∩ A is compact for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^{m′}. Then for every ω ∈ D^k(ℝ^{m′}) there is η ∈ D^k(ℝ^m) such that (i) η is compatible with (f, ω) near A: there is an open N ⊆ ℝ^m with A ⊆ N and η(x) = ω(f(x))∘(fderiv ℝ f x) for every x ∈ N; and (ii) for every C ∈ ℝ with |ω(y)| ≤ C for all y ∈ ℝ^{m′}, one has |η(x)| ≤ Λ^k·C for all x ∈ ℝ^m.
lean_statement: ∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (f : Eucl m → Eucl m') (A O : Set (Eucl m)) (Λ : ℝ≥0), IsOpen O → A ⊆ O → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → (∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ Λ) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ A)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k, ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k, (∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ A ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∧ ∀ C : ℝ, (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) y) ≤ C) → ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x) ≤ (Λ : ℝ) ^ k * C
